purpose: Measure the smallest source-grounded factual or editorial correction that produces a repeatable reduction in both ZeroGPT and Scribbr on the stable formal-news calibration window.

factors.hypothesis: A tiny correction of an AI-polish title error may change a local classifier response while improving factual fidelity.
factors.not_a_recipe: Use only when a bound source proves that the title is wrong; never replace titles merely to affect a detector.

factors.hypothesis: Removing one optional interpretive lead clause absent from the source may change a local classifier response.
factors.not_a_recipe: The clause must be unsupported and dispensable; source claims, qualifications and authorial evaluation are protected.

factors.hypothesis: Removing one AI-added metaphor absent from the source may change a local classifier response.
factors.not_a_recipe: The candidate is quality-screened before scanning and is excluded if it moves farther from the bound style reference.

factors.hypothesis: Restoring two misreported record titles and their attribution may produce a measurable cross-family response.
factors.not_a_recipe: The replacement must be recoverable from the bound source and may not broaden the record claim.

factors.hypothesis: Restoring planned-event status where AI polish falsely reported completion may produce a measurable cross-family response.
factors.not_a_recipe: Do not alter tense or modality unless the bound source establishes the event status.

factors.hypothesis: Removing one AI-invented year may produce a measurable response at very low edit cost.
factors.not_a_recipe: A number may be removed only after exact source binding and source rebaseline; detector score is never authority for a factual change.

factors.hypothesis: Restoring a materially altered direct quote and removing its invented year may produce a measurable cross-family response.
factors.not_a_recipe: Quoted text is restored from the exact bound source, not paraphrased for a classifier.

procedure: Rebuild all candidates from the exact original, bound reference and frozen plan; reject any source excerpt, plan SHA or candidate SHA mismatch.
Before candidate scans, recheck the unchanged human and AI controls once in both services with exact visible SHA and transition signal.
If any start control differs from its frozen median by more than 5 points, stop before candidates and record baseline drift.
Do not scan f3-metaphor-removal: it was excluded before scores because source-relative style distance worsened by 0.7.
Scan each eligible candidate once in both services in frozen live_order.
After every submit, require loading, disabled-state, changed result text or another explicit transition before accepting terminal DOM state.
Repeat an eligible candidate in both services to n=3 only under repeat_eligibility; do not repeat a failed candidate.
Do not create, combine, reorder or alter candidates after the preregistration commit.
Treat source-reconciled number removals as factual corrections bound to the human source, never as permission to remove numbers for a detector.
No service result may override fidelity, quote integrity, formal-news genre or C2 preservation.

success_criteria.candidate_success: The candidate satisfies cross_family_success after required repeats.
success_criteria.minimality_result: Report every candidate separately and select the lowest-edit-cost cross-family success; never substitute a deeper rewrite when a smaller complete success exists.
success_criteria.hard_threshold_context: This experiment measures local causal response. Remaining scores may exceed 20%; production F1 remains red until every mandatory service is strictly below 20%.
success_criteria.rule_admission: No candidate or factor enters production from this selected calibration text; any signal requires a new preregistered holdout and an additional independent detector group.

stopping_rules: Stop before candidate scans on control drift, source-evidence mismatch or inability to obtain transition-bound results.
Do not scan a candidate excluded by the frozen quality-first screen.
Do not add punctuation-only, synonym-only or detector-highlight-driven variants.
Do not expand the 6.61% edit-cost ceiling in micro-02.
Blocked or timed-out UI is recorded as blocked/error, never converted into a score.
